$$

By applying elementary row operations of the form $R_{i}:=R_{i}+kR_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary row operations?
question.:question/worked-solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make the entries above $a_{31}=1$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary row operations:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}6 & 9 & -9 \\ 8 & -7 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & -6\end{bmatrix}
\xrightarrow{R_{1}:=R_{1}-6R_{3}}\begin{bmatrix}0 & -9 & 27 \\ 8 & -7 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & -6\end{bmatrix}
\xrightarrow{R_{2}:=R_{2}-8R_{3}}\begin{bmatrix}0 & -9 & 27 \\ 0 & -31 & 50 \\ 1 & 3 & -6\end{bmatrix}=B
$$

Therefore, the elementary row operations are

$R_{1}:=R_{1}-6R_{3}$ and $R_{2}:=R_{2}-8R_{3}$.
